==Description==
The '''Swamp Thing''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared exclusively in [[Nightmare Carnival]] as part of the [[Halloween 2019 Event]]. While it walked quite slowly, it had very high health, with only the [[Jaxe (Nightmare Carnival)|Jaxe]] and [[Jack O' Bot]] having higher health.

The '''Swamp Thing''' could have been spawned by [[Jack O' Bot]].

==Appearance==
The '''Swamp Thing''' was a large [[Enemies|enemy]], similar in size to the [[Slow Boss]]. It had dark green marble skin and its torso and legs were dark green granite. It was also faceless. Multiple green tentacles came out from its back and green particles are emitted from its torso. Its head was slightly tilted downwards and it had no face.

==Strategy==
*Multiple [[Minigunner]]s, [[Ranger|Outlaws]] and other high DPS towers are able to defeat this [[Enemies|enemy]].
*While not having any special attacks, this is a major threat due to its high health.
** The [[Commander]] and [[Militant|John]] can help boost the DPS of towers around them, giving you a better chance of defeating the '''Swamp Thing'''.

==Trivia==
*The name of this [[Enemies|enemy]] could have been inspired by the [https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Swamp_Thing Swamp Thing] from ''Terraria'' or the [[w:c:kingdomrushtd|Swamp Thing]] from ''Kingdom Rush''.
*The '''Swamp Thing''' is very similar to the [[Swamp Monster]].
